```python
def extract_body(text, name):
    """Find definition of `name` and return its body text (or None)."""
    # candidate definitions: at line start, some modifiers, name( ... ) then {
    pat = re.compile(r'^[ \t]*(?:[A-Za-z_][\w\s\*]*?)\b' + re.escape(name) + r'\s*\(', re.M)
    for m in pat.finditer(text):
        # ensure not a call inside another function: the line should look like a definition
        # find closing paren of the arg list, then optional stuff, then '{'
        i = m.end()  # after name(
        depth = 1
        j = i
        while j < len(text) and depth > 0:
            c = text[j]
            if c == '(': depth += 1
            elif c == ')': depth -= 1
            j += 1
        # now text[j-1] == ')'
        # skip whitespace/newlines, possibly __init macros etc.
        k = j
        # skip over things like '\n{\n' or ' __init\n{'
        rest = text[k:k+200]
        mm = re.match(r'[\s\n]*(?:[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*)?\{', rest)
        if not mm:
            continue
        start = k + mm.end()  # after '{'
        # brace match
        depth = 1
        p = start
        while p < len(text) and depth > 0:
            c = text[p]
            if c == '{': depth += 1
            elif c == '}': depth -= 1
            p += 1
        return text[start:p-1]
    return None
```
